Image: Three years of Hackceler8 podium cheques for Kalmarunionen Last weekend, Kalmarunionen took 3rd place at the Google CTF Hackceler8 Finals in Singapore, competing against some of the best teams in the world! We lost to the eventual champions, BunkyoWesterns. Huge congratulations to them on a well deserved win! 👏 That makes it three consecutive podium finishes: * 🥉 2026: 3rd place * 🥇 2025: 1st place * 🥉 2024: 3rd place Why do we keep coming back? The fierce competition, the teamwork, the challenges, and most importantly, the fun of solving difficult problems together. This year was an absolute blast! Thanks to Google for hosting and to JN Data and ICSRange for helping make our participation possible, we are very grateful. 🔧 We found a hardware bug along the way! While preparing for the finals, our team discovered a hardware vulnerability in the game platform (so did other teams). Some of our dedicated team mates are working on a technical writeup that we will post on kalmarunionen.dk soon. 🔐 As Cybersecurity Awareness Month wraps up, recent vulnerabilities, data leaks, and the constant race to patch remind us just how fast cybersecurity is evolving. At Kalmarunionen, we’ve always focused on building a community where security professionals and technology enthusiasts come together to share knowledge, sharpen skills, and inspire the next generation. As cybersecurity challenges grow more complex, developing talent and strengthening our community has never been more important. We hope people will keep supporting us as they have the last 6-7 years. A sincere thank you to our sponsors and partners who make this possible through their continued support of learning, meetups, and international competition: JN Data, Conscia & ICSRange.
